sampleEstimator.median: sort ascending; odd n selects middle; even n averages the two middle values
sampleEstimator.decisionStatistic: sample median only; p95 and all confidence intervals are informational

target: snapback median divided by convex median for strictly-positive ratio metrics
bootstrap.armSampling: independent resampling with replacement within each arm; alternating execution does not imply pairing
bootstrap.prng: xorshift32 with unsigned 32-bit state; rejection sampling maps draws to sample indexes without modulo bias
bootstrap.drawOrder: for every replicate draw n Convex observations, then n Snapback observations
bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile interval using type-7 linear quantiles at 0.025 and 0.975

invalidSamples.rule: retain every invalid observation; only a preregistered instrument failure with a named documenter and non-empty rationale invalidates
invalidSamples.replacement: repeat the same arm at the same sequence slot until seven valid samples exist; never discard or repeat an already-valid opposite-arm observation
invalidSamples.maximumInvalidReplacements: none; any inability to obtain seven valid samples is a required skip and blocks the checkpoint
